mechanism: Posaconazole inhibits CYP3A4, which can increase valproic acid levels; additionally, both drugs are hepatically metabolized and valproic acid may displace posaconazole from protein binding, increasing free drug exposure.
action: Monitor valproic acid serum levels closely; consider therapeutic drug monitoring and assess for valproic acid toxicity signs (tremor, sedation, ataxia); dose adjustment of valproic acid may be necessary.
